request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fabric, building and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A POLICE OFFICER. A woman of about thirty with dark hair in a bun stands on a city sidewalk in a plain dark-blue police uniform with a peaked police cap, a plain silver star badge with no writing, a duty belt and a radio on her shoulder; a patrol car with a blue light bar on its roof is parked behind her. She stands straight and looks at the camera with a calm, friendly face. The uniform, the cap and the car carry no writing at all. Exactly one person, whole upper body sharp and large in the middle of the photo; the workplace behind is plain to read but not crowded. No letters, words, numbers, logos, badges with writing or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
